column1: # gates-pop.ledger.tsv -- GENERATED by `gates/gates-pop.py --write-ledger --only PATH`, which is its ONLY writer: it writes
# the named paths and no others. A bare `--write-ledger` is REFUSED. It writes on NO other invocation, and every
# other invocation only READS it. Written by `gates/gates-pop.py`, a generator over the tree's gate homes --
# so this file is a SHARED WRITABLE PATH, and a run that rewrites it without a path absorbs whatever else the
# tree held. A record of gates that were DISCOVERED, not a list of gates that exist: `reason=gone` is a row
# saying one LEFT. MERGED, NEVER REWRITTEN -- every edit adds information, so no edit goes green by erasing.
